# Outtalent launches for developers from all countries, pay only if you get a top job


## Are you a software engineer looking to 10x your career and join a top company like Google? Apply by July 15th to get one of our 24 spots


[Tilek Mamutov](https://medium.com/@tilek?source=post_page---byline--4fe291f961b---------------------------------------)


2 min read


·


Jun 28, 2021


--


Press enter or click to view image in full size


### What is Outtalent?


We are an online educational program designed to help great software engineers get jobs at top companies like Google. Participants pay only if they get the job they wanted.


We aim to help people from all countries set and achieve ambitious career goals together, independent of where they are born, where they live, or what’s said on their passport.


Our core program lasts for 3 months and it covers distributed system design, algorithms, data structures, personal branding, and salary negotiation.


### Our accomplishments


We have been running our career accelerator in the Russian-speaking region for the past 2 years and we’ve helped get offers from Amazon, DeepMind, Facebook, Flexport, Google, Microsoft, Reddit, Spotify, Stripe, TikTok, and Uber in Europe, Canada, and the US. Our most popular employer is Google and our most popular destination is London.


Outtalent’s last batch was the strongest yet:


- On average, graduates got 3 offers from one of the top tech companies of their choice, at minimum, they got 2 offers
- Their average base salary reached 115k USD/year (not counting the stock compensation and bonuses)
- 100% of graduates got an offer at either Google, Facebook, Amazon, or Microsoft and[shared testimonials](https://outtalent.com/community/index.html)


We also are very proud of the mentorship team that we built. It consists of experienced engineers and engineering managers like[Usman Masood](https://www.linkedin.com/in/umasood/) (Pipe, Stripe, Facebook, Microsoft, MIT),[Dan Silva](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielribeirosilva/) (X, Google, Apple, Amazon, Microsoft),[Nikita Podguzov](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikita-podguzov-43601715a/) (Google), and[Dima Korolev](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dimakorolev/) (Poker Stars, Google, Microsoft).


### Expanding internationally


We are going to run 3 simultaneous international batches, with a limited 8 fellows in each of them. So if you are looking to apply to big tech companies or top startups in the next few months, fill out our 2-min eligibility check at:[https://outtalent.com/check](https://outtalent.com/check)


Software engineers from all countries are now invited to apply!


### Want to know more?


If you are still wondering whether it’s best to apply to companies by yourself, we recommend you check out this[article](https://medium.com/outtalent/5-practical-reasons-why-you-should-use-a-career-accelerator-c272df2f7a5d) we wrote on why it’s beneficial to prepare and apply with Outtalent.
